requirements.title: Security controls
requirements.description: Verify authentication, isolation, secret handling, and privileged capability guards.

evidence.environment: Windows 10 Pro x64 + Docker Desktop 29.7.2; MyBay OSS 0.1.27 isolated production build; Hermes v2026.8.27 with upgrade/rollback through v2026.8.31; credentialed browser acceptance
evidence.command: Authenticated browser acceptance + anonymous HTTP probes + deployed-container inspection + focused security test suite
evidence.note: Anonymous protected routes failed closed, authenticated private paths remained blocked, focused security tests passed, and the loopback Runtime container remained non-privileged and resource-limited without a Docker socket.

requirements.title: Backup and restore
requirements.description: Restore a supported backup and verify Runtime data through the product path.

evidence.environment: Windows 10 Pro x64 + Docker Desktop 29.7.2; MyBay OSS 0.1.27 isolated production build; Hermes v2026.8.27 with upgrade/rollback through v2026.8.31; credentialed browser acceptance
evidence.command: MyBay UI: isolated test Agent -> export redacted backup -> import preview -> create stopped clone -> rebind credential and set new password -> initial deployment -> file-center preview -> delete disposable clone
evidence.note: A redacted validated archive restored to a disposable clone; the clone automatically converged to running/healthy, rendered the byte-identical output in the file center, and completed a credentialed browser model task.
